reported.title: Fan relay chatters on noise and threshold hover
reported.description: The control logic at lines 72-79 is a bare threshold with no hysteresis and no debounce: every 50 ms tick (line 65) it calls setFan(true) when tempC >= 28.0 and setFan(false) otherwise, so any noise or a signal hovering at the threshold flips D9 on each sample. Measured evidence confirms this: 8 toggles in a 5000 ms window in the glitch-spike scenario, 46 toggles in the threshold-hover scenario, and 34 toggles in the rapid-oscillation scenario, all far above the limit of 2. The spec's 24.0 °C close threshold is never implemented, so there is no dead band to suppress chatter. D9 toggled 46 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 1.30 s (limit 2), and 64 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

reported.title: No fault detection or forced safe state for out-of-range probe
reported.description: The firmware never checks for a floating probe or for temperatures below 5.0 °C or above 100.0 °C; readTempC (lines 19-24) returns the raw conversion and loop only compares against OPEN_C at line 72, so a 3 °C reading simply drives the fan OFF via line 78. Measured evidence shows D9 was not HIGH for 5400 ms during the disconnected-sensor fault and 3400 ms during the max/min range fault, versus the 600 ms allowed, and the sub-5 °C scenario shows repeated non-safe intervals (780 ms, 160 ms, 120 ms). No safe-state hold exists anywhere in the code. During the fault, D9 was not in safe state HIGH for 1080 ms (allowed 600 ms to react).

judge_input.spec:
- LM35 greenhouse air probe on A2 at 10 mV/°C; exhaust fan relay on D9.
- Open the fan when temperature reaches 28.0 °C or above; close the fan when temperature falls to 24.0 °C or below.
- Fan must not change state more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- If the probe is floating, or temperature reads below 5.0 °C or above 100.0 °C, force the fan ON within 600 ms and hold that safe state for the duration of the fault.
- Print `gh: <temp> C fan=ON` or `gh: <temp> C fan=OFF` every 1000 ms with temperature to one decimal place.
- Reach the commanded fan state within 500 ms of a sustained in-range band crossing.
